'''2001 Nevada State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Nevada in 2001.<ref name="dt-15273">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15273 Xizor - Head PIMP], DeckTech (Ben "Jigglypimp" Cavin, 14 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15273/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15273/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 15 April 2001<ref name="tr-d2080" />
* '''Site:''' Nevada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Hines]]<ref name="tr-d2080" />
* '''Players:''' 19<ref name="tr-d2080" />

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Dan Christy finished runner-up with a Light Watch Your Step deck, 10–2 overall in his tournament play.<ref name="dt-15413" /> Cavin's Dark Agents Of Black Sun deck went undefeated at Nevada States.<ref name="dt-15273" />

== Tournament reports ==

Players' own reports from this event.

* [[Danny Rider 4-15-01 Nevada States (tournament report)]] — by [[Danny Rider]], 7th, 4–2
* [[Dan Christy Desert Showdown NV States (tournament report)]] — by [[Dan Christy]], 2nd, 6–2

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The hub dates the event 'before 14 April' from Ben Cavin's DeckTech post dated 14 April 2001, but Danny Rider's report is titled 4-15-01 and posted 15 April, and his 8 April report calls states 'next week'.<ref name="tr-d2080" />
* The hub says Dan Christy went '10–2 overall'; his report gives 10 (+78) tournament points from a 5–1 Swiss record, then a 1–1 final against Chris Hines.<ref name="tr-d2086" />
* The hub says Ben Cavin's Agents Of Black Sun deck went undefeated at Nevada States; Christy's report says that after round 3 only Chris Hines, Kris Lavigne and Brandon Gravo were undefeated, and Cavin is not in his top 4 (the deck may have won all its own games).<ref name="tr-d2086" />
